newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks close up on late blue chip surge.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks close up on late blue chip surge.

text.p: Shares in Singapore closed slightly firmer on Wednesday after a late push from international buyers on blue chip stocks helped prices move upwards, dealers said.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index ended up 8.64 points at 2,194.36 after a late surge in the stock of motor retailer Cycle & Carriage and drinks company Fraser & Neave.
Cycle & Carriage made the day's biggest gain, up Singapore $0.40 to S$16.00, while Fraser & Neave was up S$0.30 at S$15.10.
Meanwhile shares in defence company Avimo were suspended ahead of an expected results announcement on Thursday.
Moderate market volume of 142.62 million units saw 211 losers and 131 gainers.
"It has been a quiet day with the broad market showing no change," said one dealer.
Another dealer said Singapore shares were waiting for inspiration from overseas. "All the sentiment has gone in Malaysia and I think the market is waiting for better news from Wall Street," he said.
Gains in recent weeks in Malaysian stock prices, recorded on the over-the-counter UOB OTC index, were absent and the index closed down 3.55 at 1,210.52. -- Nick Edwards (65 8703011)
